scientific.integrity: The result is derived from the exact switched-affine scalar recurrence. Existence follows by solving the two-cycle equations, local stability by the second-order Jury criterion, and the supercritical behavior by an exact magnitude recurrence. The checker is only an algebra/transcription guard.
limitations: The theorem fixes the scalar preconditioner and does not cover the time-varying adaptive second-moment state of AdaSAM/Adam/AMSGrad.
The local stability result is for the nonzero sign-alternating orbit on a one-dimensional positive quadratic.
The normalized EMA convention \(m_t=\beta m_{t-1}+(1-\beta)g_t\) is essential to the displayed raw-step formula.
No stochastic, multidimensional, nonquadratic, generalization, or global subcritical convergence claim is made.

title: Exact cycle-stability frontier for scalar SAM with EMA momentum
